about: Golden fixtures produced by the ORIGINAL Mutant Brain Surgery ASP code (executed under Windows Script Host by tools/asp-oracle). Regenerate with `npm run fixtures`.

fixtures.description: Split: input 1 notes 0-59 chan 2, input 2 notes 60-127 chan 2, min velocity 64
Values chosen then input disabled: nothing but src is sent
CV A-D: note pitch 1-4 of inputs 1-4, transposes and schemes
CV A/B: velocity of inputs 1/2, range 1V and 8V
CV A-D: MIDI CC on omni/default/chan 5/chan 16, CCs 1/7/74/127, ranges 2-8V
CV A: pitch bend chan 3 5V, CV B: aftertouch default chan 1V
CV A: BPM to CV, CV B: fixed voltage (the range is NOT sent by the original site)
Gates 1-6: note input events first/second/third/fourth/any on/all off
Gates 1-4: MIDI note single/range, chan specific/omni/default, velocity thresholds
Gates 1-4: CC above/below threshold, thresholds 1/64/127, channels
Gates 1-3: clock tick+run, last 3 dividers, tick offsets
Values chosen then gate disabled: only src and (1,0) duration are sent
Full 4-voice poly: 4 inputs (4-note cycle), pitch CVs, gate per voice, clock + transport
Input 1 as 4-note chord driving CV A-D pitches 1-4 and velocity gates
Every enabled field at its last option
File with the legacy device id 00 7F 12: accepted, re-saved with 00 7F 15
CV A on CC 6 (a disabled dropdown option): shown selected but not submitted => saved as CC 0
CV source 3 (CC negative) has no CV dropdown option => form shows "(disable)"
Values with no dropdown option (17ms, max note 0, min vel 0) fall back to the first option
No parameters at all: every field keeps its default
Parameters out of order with duplicates: the last one wins
Unknown parameter ids (calibration, split, glide, save) are ignored
